subject: general
question:
In this question, there are three statements showing the relation, which follow the three conclusions i, ii and iii. Believing the statement as true, ﬁnd out which ﬁndings are completely true.

**Statement:** A ≤ B N; N > C = T

**Conclusion:**

i) B T

iii) A < C
solution:
Given: A ≤ B N; N > C = T

After merging all the statements together, we get:

A ≤ B N > C = T

 i) B N, clear relation between B and N cannot be determined)

ii) E > T → True (As, E > N > C = T, so E > T)

iii) A N > C, clear relation between A and C cannot be determined)

Hence, only ii) follows.
